findings.title: Migration schema sound — 3 decimal(10,2) nullable columns + idempotent down()
findings.description: Branch additions: delivery_fee_base, delivery_fee_per_km, delivery_fee_minimum, all decimal(10,2) nullable. Migration places columns ->after('zone'). Down() correctly drops all three in a single Schema::table block. NULL semantics documented in doc-block (legacy fallback). No FK needed (branch-scoped already).

findings.title: delivery_minimum_order column sound — single decimal(10,2) nullable
findings.description: Single column, NULL = no minimum (V1 default). Wired to OrderRequest:265-287 validateDeliveryMinimumOrder. Migration reversible. Branch model fillable+cast verified (app/Models/Branch.php:22+48).
findings.evidence: Migration line 18 ->nullable() after('delivery_fee_minimum'). Branch.php:22 fillable + :48 cast decimal:2.

findings.title: deliveryBoyOrder query — composite index (delivery_boy_id, status, branch_id) recommended
findings.description: OrderService::deliveryBoyOrder filters Order WHERE order_type != POS AND delivery_boy_id = ? AND branch_id = ?. Verified at lines 283-286. The query then ORDER BY (default 'id desc'). With high order volume, a composite index on (delivery_boy_id, branch_id) covers list+count efficiently. Existing index on delivery_boy_id alone (if any) may not be optimal.
findings.reproduction: grep delivery_boy_id orders migrations to verify current index coverage.
findings.evidence: Service uses 3-column WHERE + ORDER BY id desc.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 backlog: add composite index orders(delivery_boy_id, branch_id, status, created_at). Defer — not gating V1.

findings.title: Two near-identical count queries — could be a single GROUP BY
findings.description: deliveryBoyOrderCount line 1475-1482 runs two separate COUNT queries (delivered, returned). Refactor to single SELECT status, COUNT(*) GROUP BY status WHERE delivery_boy_id=? AND status IN (DELIVERED, RETURNED).

summary: 2 migrations schema-sound (INFO). 1 P2 index recommendation + 1 P3 optimization — both deferred-heal. No P0/P1 DBA finding.
